question: What is the average review score of delivered orders that arrived after the estimated delivery date?
sql:
WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date
)
SELECT AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM delivered d
JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = d.order_id
plan: • Identify delivered orders where order_status = 'delivered'. • Filter those orders where order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date to find late deliveries. • Join the filtered orders to the reviews table on order_id to associate review scores. • Use the review_score column from reviews. • Compute the average of review_score across all matching records.
